# Build with FSC

> > Build with FSC promotes Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certification for sustainable forestry, mass timber construction, and climate-smart green building practices.

This site serves architects, builders, and construction professionals seeking FSC-certified wood products for sustainable building projects. It provides resources on forest certification benefits, LEED credits, mass timber applications, and showcases successful green building projects that meet Living Building Challenge and other sustainability standards.

## Key Topics

- FSC certification
- Forest Stewardship Council
- Mass timber
- Green building
- Sustainable forestry
- LEED credits
- Climate-smart forestry
- Living Building Challenge
- Sustainable construction
- Forest carbon
- FSC Leadership Awards
- Architects and builders
- Sustainable wood products
- Forest certification standards

- [WHY FSC](https://www.buildwithfsc.org/why-fsc): Why choose FSC for sustainable forestry and climate-smart building
- [BENEFITS](https://www.buildwithfsc.org/benefits): FSC certification benefits for sustainable forestry and green building
- [BENEFITS FOR PROS](https://www.buildwithfsc.org/benefits-for-pros): FSC benefits for architects and builders: LEED credits and mass timber
